transcript.text: Hi there! Welcome to flight booking. I'm here to help you book a flight from San Francisco to New York. Let me get started on that for you right away.

Great! So I have three dates available for you: July 20th, 21st, or 22nd, 2026. Which of those works best for you? And do you have any preferences, like whether you want the cheapest option, the fastest flight, non-stop service, or a particular departure time?
Hey there! I need to book a flight from San Francisco to New York JFK for July 21st next year. Can you help me with that?

Absolutely, I can help you with that! July 21st works perfectly. Now, do you have any preferences for that flight—would you like the cheapest option, the fastest flight, non-stop service, or do you have a preferred departure time?
Yeah, I definitely need nonstop only, and I want a morning departure - before noon. Also, my budget is $400 max. Can you see how many nonstop options there are in the morning?

Perfect! Let me show you what we have for nonstop flights in the morning under four hundred dollars. We've got three options: Delta Nine departing at six fifteen in the morning, arriving at nine forty, that's four hundred twenty dollars; Cirrus at nine forty five arriving at one five, that's three hundred eighty five dollars; and Blue Sky at one o'clock arriving at four twenty, that's four hundred fifty five dollars. So based on your budget and preferences, the Cirrus flight at nine forty five for three hundred eighty five dollars would be your best match—it's nonstop, it's in your morning window, and it's under your four hundred dollar budget. Does that sound good to you? And I'll need your full name and email to complete the booking.

Perfect, so to confirm—you'd like me to book that Cirrus flight departing at nine forty five for three hundred eighty five dollars on July twenty first? I'll just need your full name and email address to get that locked in for you.

Sounds like you're all set with the Cirrus flight—nonstop, departing at 9:45 in the morning, arriving at 1:05 PM, and it's $385, which is under your budget. Before I book it, I'll just need your full name and email address.

Wait, hold on - you said there were three options but the Delta at 6:15 was $420, which is over my $400 budget. So really just the Cirrus at $385 fits what I need, right? And that's definitely the final price - $385?

You're absolutely right—I apologize for that confusion. The Delta option at four twenty is over your budget, so the Cirrus flight at nine forty five for three eighty five is really your only nonstop option in the morning that fits your criteria. And yes, three eighty five is the final price. So let me go ahead and book that for you—I'll just need your full name and email address.
Okay great, that works for me. My name is Daniel Ortiz and my email is d.ortiz@ortizconsulting.com
Perfect! Let me get that booked for you right away with those details.
Sounds good, thanks! Let me know when it's confirmed.
Perfect, Daniel! I'm getting that booked for you right now with the Cirrus flight on July 21st at 9:45 AM for $385. Let me just confirm everything is submitted and I'll let you know in just a moment.

Excellent news, Daniel! Your flight is officially booked and confirmed. You're all set for Cirrus flight FL110 on July 21st, 2026, departing San Francisco at 9:45 in the morning and arriving in New York at 1:05 PM. It's nonstop, $385, and your confirmation number is B-1. You should receive a confirmation email at d.ortiz@ortizconsulting.com shortly.
